role: Operationalize the exact-current audit rule CAPABILITY_FAMILY_CHECKPOINT_CURVES_REQUIRED; AGGREGATE_CONVERGENCE_IS_INSUFFICIENT without creating a new semantic or versioning authority.

research_basis.source: Wu, Geiger & Milliere, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, ICML 2025 / arXiv:2505.20896
research_basis.direct_finding: The studied Transformer passed through random prediction, a shallow early-assignment heuristic, and a later systematic dereferencing mechanism; causal interventions supported the later mechanism interpretation.
research_basis.project_implication: A Qwen3.5 binder pilot must preserve longitudinal checkpoints and explicit heuristic baselines; endpoint accuracy cannot identify the learned mechanism.

research_basis.source: Xue et al., Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn, ACL 2026
research_basis.direct_finding: The current-main audit cites this work for the risk that aggregate convergence hides systematically unlearned subsets.
research_basis.project_implication: Track capability-family curves separately rather than only aggregate train/validation loss.

research_basis.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models, arXiv:2505.22637
research_basis.direct_finding: Steering effects vary across prompts/samples; coherence and separability of activation differences predict better reliability.
research_basis.project_implication: J-Space/vector-control curves need held-out prompt-family sign stability, geometry/coherence and off-target controls.

research_basis.source: Sankaranarayanan et al., Surgical Activation Steering via Generative Causal Mediation, arXiv:2602.16080
research_basis.direct_finding: In their tested tasks/models, causal-mediation component selection outperformed correlational probe baselines for sparse steering.
research_basis.project_implication: Decodability curves nominate representations; causal promotion remains a separate intervention axis.

preregistered_checkpoint_schedule.rule: Freeze the schedule before the pilot and before inspecting final holdout behavior. Values are normalized optimizer progress, not fixed step counts.
preregistered_checkpoint_schedule.allowed_reduction: A resource-constrained pilot may use a strict preregistered subset, but must retain baseline, at least two interior early/mid checkpoints, and final checkpoint.
preregistered_checkpoint_schedule.event_triggered_extra: Optional saves at preregistered validation thresholds; thresholds and metric names must be frozen before training and may not use final holdout.
forbidden: choosing checkpoints after seeing holdout behavior
discarding a heuristic-dominant checkpoint from provenance
using holdout failures to change the schedule

shortcut_controls: learned nuisance-only challenger on disjoint families

capability_family_curves.holdout_requirement: At least one smaller and one larger unseen N relative to training values; exact values freeze in split manifest.

binding_mechanism_phase_labels.purpose: Diagnostic labels for the learning trajectory, never canonical truth.
systematic_candidate_minimum: intended binding metrics generalize on frozen unseen families
model-visible semantic-ablation exact-signature lookup is at episode-local chance
learned nuisance-only challenger remains within preregistered tolerance
codebook/state minimal-pair sensitivities have the expected direction
binding_mechanism_phase_labels.causal_supported_additional: Exact-model/runtime intervention evidence must satisfy the current J-Space/representation causal gate; behavioral success alone cannot enter this state.

jspace_curve_and_promotion_axis.meaning: Exact hidden-state/activation capture at exact checkpoint/runtime identity.
Direction/coherence/separability stable across preregistered prompt families and checkpoints.
Intended behavior/state changes more than random/orthogonal/permuted same-norm controls at exact identity.
Semantic and binding lesions separate predicted functions; rescue restores the lesioned function while off-target floors remain intact.
jspace_curve_and_promotion_axis.claim_limit: model-specific mechanism evidence; never canonical state/effect authority

promotion_rule: Never promote from aggregate endpoint accuracy. Require a frozen family-by-checkpoint matrix showing intended capabilities emerging while preregistered shortcuts remain below tolerance; preserve negative/intermediate checkpoints. J-Space causal language requires the separate intervention level at exact identity.
nonclaims: No Qwen3.5-0.8B training or checkpoint exists from this contract.
No mechanism transition has been observed for the target model.
No J-Space vector, subspace or causal mechanism is promoted.
No ledger v3 is created here; version-ledger authority remains a separate convergence task identified by the exact-current audit.
No accepted dataset tokens or training credit are minted.
next_exact_action: When the canonical Hyperposition schema/gate/labeler dependency converges, bind this contract into the frozen training recipe and receipt schema; then run the exact serialized binder nuisance gates before admitting the smallest authorized zero-cost pilot.
